ios.desc:
Effortless AI Calorie Tracking
Track calories with ease and just snap a photo or describe your meal in a few words. Our AI does the rest with accurate, smart recognition.
No ads.
Access the AI scanner with either your own API key or a subscription, completely flexible.
Log all your meals in one clean place, set goals, and stay consistent with helpful reminders. Search your local database anytime without internet. Available in 6 languages.
Whether you want to lose weight, eat healthier, or simply understand your nutrition better, this is calorie counting made simple and modern.
Key Features:

AI-powered photo & text food recognition
Fast and accurate calorie & nutrition tracking
No manual entry required
Clean, clutter-free interface
Works offline with local database
Flexible AI access (your API key or subscription)
Reminders to help you stay consistent

Download now and simplify your health journey.
